payload.artist_html: L. Xing, R. C. McKellar, J. K. O'Connor, K. Niu & H. Mai
payload.credit_html: "A mid-Cretaceous enantiornithine foot and tail feather preserved in Burmese amber"
payload.description_html: Overview and X-ray micro-CT renderings of YLSNHM01001, the holotype of Fortipesavis prehendens. (A,B) Foot and flight feathers in dorsal and ventral views, respectively; with foot located ventral to feathers. (C,D) Corresponding micro-CT renderings with inset showing approximate reconstruction of digit proportions (additional details presented in Fig. 2). Arrowheads point to distal end of foot, inclined arrows to base of rectrix; vertical arrows to base of RDF; roman numerals indicate digit numbers. Scale bars = 5 mm.
